note: Published numbers are on the full sets and count RMSD only. AlphaFold3's figure is for pocket-unconditioned prediction. Our 32-complex subset carries about ±8 percentage points of sampling error (binomial, 1 sigma), so read the comparison with that in mind. Vina and GOLD rows use the PoseBusters paper's released per-complex results on exactly our 32 complexes, with the crystal protein and pocket given to them, which is an easier task than co-folding.
